title: Unicode Blocks
description: All 353 Unicode blocks in Unicode 18.0.0 — 316,784 code points, from Basic Latin at U+0000..U+007F to Supplementary Private Use Area-B at U+100000..U+10FFFF — with start, end and block size.

id.description: Slug of the block name, for URLs

name.description: Block name exactly as Blocks.txt writes it

start.description: First code point, hexadecimal as published

end.description: Last code point, hexadecimal as published

startCode.description: First code point as an integer

endCode.description: Last code point as an integer

size.description: Number of code points in the block
